description.value: Sun Sui Wah is a long-established Cantonese seafood restaurant with origins in Hong Kong spanning over 30 years, celebrated as one of Vancouver's most recognized Chinese dining destinations. The Richmond location on busy No. 3 Road is one of two BC outposts, serving dim sum, fresh seafood, and the restaurant's signature award-winning roasted squab. It has been a repeat winner of Georgia Straight Golden Plates readers' choice awards.
